conflicts.explanation: Indonesia’s current Immigration schedule expressly places Israel in the Calling Visa group, requiring Directorate clearance before a visa is issued. It does not establish an unconditional ordinary short-visitor instrument, its issuance form or timing, so this exceptional regime cannot be normalized as visa_required.

unresolved.reason: Afghanistan’s current Foreign Ministry tourist page states only generic purpose and document terms. No current accessible Afghan primary source directly maps an ordinary Israeli passport to short-visitor eligibility or an actual issuance route and timing; no diplomatic-relations, portal or other-document inference is made.

No current accessible Bangladeshi primary source directly maps an ordinary Israeli passport to a short-visitor eligibility decision and actual issuance route or timing. Online-form access, fee information, an omission, Bangladesh-origin NVR routes and bilateral-relation assertions are not used as evidence.

Indonesia’s current Immigration schedule expressly requires Calling Visa clearance for Israeli nationals before a visa is issued. It does not identify a single unconditional ordinary short-visitor instrument or its electronic, consular or border issuance timing; the conditional regime is recorded as a conflict rather than normalized as visa_required.

The current DPRK Embassy in Warsaw confirms only a generic consular visa-application channel and fee, not ordinary Israeli-passport eligibility, a visitor route, duration or issuance timing. Central DPRK Foreign Ministry and state-portal endpoints could not be replayed with trusted TLS; no tour-operator, recognition or portal inference is made.

No current accessible Pakistani primary source directly maps an ordinary Israeli passport to short-visitor eligibility, an entry prohibition, or actual visa issuance timing. The live DGI&P page's isolated ‘except Israel’ wording is inside an HTML comment within 2024 content, so it is not current operative guidance. Tourist-list omission, online-form access and non-recognition assertions are not used as evidence.

No current accessible Turkmen primary source directly maps an ordinary Israeli passport to the legal default, a treaty exception, visitor eligibility or actual issuance timing. The live state-portal migration-law page is dated 2012, and its 2026 page-modification metadata does not establish that the text is a current consolidated instrument. No residual-complement, treaty, invitation or portal inference is made.
